# TerrainDetail <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Terrain](Blitz3D-Terrain)

</div>


```blitzbasic
TerrainDetail:Void terrain:Int32, detail_level:Int32, morph:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `terrain` | In | Int32 | required | The terrain. |
| `detail_level` | In | Int32 | required | Number of triangles to use. |
| `morph` | In | Int32 | `0` | True to blend between levels of detail. Defaults to False. |

## Description

Chooses how many triangles the terrain may use at a time, about 2000 being typical, and whether the vertices blend smoothly between levels of detail to hide the changes.

## Differences

* The terrain has no level of detail here. All of its triangles are always drawn, so the call is accepted and does nothing.
